register.labelZh: FLIP 片語動詞的實際用途
register.summaryZh: flip for 可以表示突然非常喜歡某人或某事物;flip out 則可以描述強烈的情緒反應。；flip over 可以描述快速翻轉;flip through 則可以描述快速翻閱書頁、照片或訊息。；當人們未能決定誰得到某物或誰先做時,可以用 flip for 表示擲硬幣作決定。；認識 flip somebody off,可以幫助你理解電影、網上影片和對話,同時知道這個手勢十分粗魯。
register.summaryEn: Flip for can describe suddenly liking someone or something very much. Flip out can describe a powerful emotional reaction. Flip over describes a quick turn, while flip through describes looking through pages, photographs or messages quickly. Flip for can show that people use a coin when they cannot agree on who should receive something or act first. Knowing flip somebody off helps you understand films, online videos and conversations while recognising that the gesture is rude.
